content:
WeaponModel

Defines weapon properties including cooldown, ammunition, visuals, and components.

Model

Schema

JSON
{
  "cooldown": 0.5,
  "maxAmmo": 30,
  "visual": {
    "sprite": "sprites/weapons/pistol",
    "scale": 1.0,
    "flipX": false,
    "flipY": false,
    "color": "#FFFFFF",
    "opacity": 1.0
  },
  "components": {
    "muzzleFlash": { "enabled": true },
    "recoil": { "strength": 0.2 }
  }
}

Description

The WeaponModel defines the core properties of a weapon in the Blastback Engine. It specifies the attack cooldown rate, maximum ammunition capacity, the visual appearance of the weapon via a nested VisualModel, and an extensible dictionary of weapon-specific components. This model serves as the base for all weapon types and can be extended by PersistentWeaponModel for weapons that persist across scenes.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
cooldownfloatTime in seconds between consecutive attacks. Lower values mean faster fire rate.
maxAmmointMaximum ammunition the weapon can hold. Set to -1 for unlimited ammo.
visualVisualModelThe visual properties of the weapon, defined as a VisualModel.
componentsDictionary<string, Object>A dictionary of weapon-specific components keyed by component name. Allows attaching custom behaviors and configuration to the weapon.

Example

JSON
{
  "cooldown": 0.25,
  "maxAmmo": 60,
  "visual": {
    "sprite": "sprites/weapons/assault_rifle",
    "scale": 1.2,
    "flipX": false,
    "flipY": false,
    "color": "#FFFFFF",
    "opacity": 1.0
  },
  "components": {
    "muzzleFlash": { "enabled": true, "duration": 0.05 },
    "recoil": { "strength": 0.4, "recovery": 0.1 },
    "shellEject": { "direction": "right", "force": 2.0 }
  }
}

Related

  • VisualModel — Used for the weapon's visual appearance
  • PersistentWeaponModel — Extends WeaponModel with persistence across scenes
  • ProjectileModel — Defines projectile behavior for ranged weapons
  • ParticleSpawnModel — Particle effects for weapon firing
